description:
[Game reference] Rust's official game and loading-screen tips, in any rust.wiki language. `groups`: topics, each with its `tips` - `key` (the game's phrase key), `kind` (game = in-game hint, menu = loading
screen), `text` with key binds filled in as `[Key]` (Rust's default binds), `segments` (`k`: t text / k key / v value),
`source` (official = Facepunch's own wording; machine = our translation for Indonesian/Thai, which Rust doesn't ship;
english = the game has no translation in that language), `links` (related wiki pages). `binds`: the default keys used. lang= gives the tips in Facepunch's own translation (id/th are ours). Keys are Rust's defaults. Link https://rust.wiki/tips.

lang.description: Language code: en or one of the wiki's 18 (de, es, ja, ru, zh, pt-br, ...).
